claims.sentence_start: Copy-text Farmer 1998
The numeral '.xlvii.' is the reading of the print

claims.note: T2M4: 'From this conclusion and number 46 of the unusual theses on new doctrine'.

claims.sentence_start: Pico's own opinion: the fourth magical conclusion
Thesis 3>46
The thesis is a syllogism stated in one sentence
Farmer reads the pair 9>3-4 as claiming
Taken together, he writes
claims.note: 'these theses' are the list at 7233-7260, which includes 9>3 and 9>4 (7235-7238).

claims.sentence_start: The operation required is not the mastery of nature
claims.note: Farmer says mankind is ruled by the lowest order of angels and governs the material world; the magus, as a man, falls under it.

claims.sentence_start: The Oration uses the same image
claims.note: Oration 59: 'the magus is Nature's minister, not her Artificer'.

claims.sentence_start: Copenhaver reads the nobility differently
claims.note: Copenhaver's height argument explains Pico's defence of T2M9 (certainty); of T2M4 he says only that it 'follows from a related line of reasoning' (17652-17653). He does not set his reading against another ('differently').

claims.sentence_start: The cross-reference is faulty
In his note on the editio princeps Farmer argues
claims.note: This is Farmer's introductory note to 6>1-10 (on the printers' change of manuscript), not a note 'on the editio princeps' as such; the content (two theses from 4>1-29, one from 3>1-71; theses added or subtracted while in press) is accurate.

claims.sentence_start: Pico's own copy of the text was numbered
For Pico natural philosophy
In the Apology Pico repeated the claim
claims.note: Of the two formulas Mandosio quotes, only 'apicem et fastigium totius philosophiae' ('the highest point of all philosophy') is from the Apology (ibid., V, p. 170; Farmer gives 'Apology, in Opera, 170' at farmer1998:7252). 'the absolute fulfillment of natural philosophy' renders 'nihil est aliud, cum bene exploratur, quam naturalis philosophiae absoluta consummatio' (Pico [1969], p. 120), which is the Oration (cf. copenhaver2019:19585-19586, 'nothing more than the final realization of natural philosophy').

claims.sentence_start: The editors of the Cambridge Oration record
claims.note: Borghesi, Papio and Riva 2012 (Cambridge Core headers confirm the publisher).

claims.sentence_start: Farmer uses the pair 9>3-4 against Yates's claim
The operative side of Pico's magic, he argues
claims.note: Fall and redemption at 7280-7289; the phrase 'the magus as cosmic priest' is at farmer1998:7347 (also 8000). Locator should read farmer1998:7280-7289; farmer1998:7347.

claims.sentence_start: Copenhaver derives the thesis from the reasoning
claims.note: Copenhaver says T2M4 'follows from a related line of reasoning', not from the reasoning of the defence of 9>9 itself; duplicate of the doctrine sentence.

claims.sentence_start: Mandosio states the general principle
claims.note: The principle (3>46) is supported; 'quotes both formulas from the Apology' is not: the first formula is from the Oration (see reception).

claims.sentence_start: The thesis shows Pico building a claim
claims.note: Declared editorial inference. 'censorship he imposed on his own text' goes a step beyond Farmer's 'presumably due to theological dangers' (23421-23422) and 'almost surely for theological reasons' (1487), but is labelled inference.

claims.sentence_start: Why the thesis was dropped
claims.note: The Oration's editors (Borghesi, Papio, Riva) are not 'Farmer's editors'. Farmer's own statement is at farmer1998:1486-1487: 'one thesis was removed from this section while the work was in press, almost surely for theological reasons. See thesis 9>4 and note.'

translation.note: Checked against farmer1998:25125-25126 and the sense of Farmer's English at 25165-25166. 'ex ista conclusione' rendered 'the preceding conclusion' (an interpretation, correct: 9>3); numeral kept as printed; 'nobilissima pars scientiae naturalis' kept.

note: One NOT SUPPORTED clause (an Oration formula presented as the Apology's) removed, with Farmer's Apology locator added; one duplicate over-reaching sentence removed; 'differently' removed; one locator extended (cosmic priest at 7347); the not_established note re-pointed to Farmer's own statement at 1487.
